lines.t: Yeah, I was out there in the tall grass, minding my own
Just a kid in the dirt a long way from my throne
Me in the moonlight, me in the quiet
Had a heart full of praise, didn't need a riot
Then the oil started drippin', yeah, it ran down my face
Changed my whole world, changed my whole pace
Just a shepherd with a sling, but I'm feelin' the fire
Pluckin' out a melody on a golden lyre
And they told me I was small, told me I was last
But the Lord's got a future that'll bury the past
So I'm dancin' like I'm crazy in the middle of the street
With the joy of the Spirit movin' through my feet
I don't care who's watchin', I don't care who's there
I'm just a young man living on a stone in the prairie
It's a beautiful sound, it's a beautiful thing
To be dancing in the presence of the king of kings
Yeah, for the king of kings
Five stones in my pocket, one shot in the dark
Took a giant of a man just to find a spark
It wasn't the armor, it wasn't the sword
It was the power of the name of the living Lord
Now I'm singing these songs under neon light
Keeping the faith in the middle of the night
I was the problem till he became the solution
Starting up a holy kind, a revolution
From the field to the ground, from the dust to the gold
It's the greatest story that's ever been told
So I'm dancing like I'm crazy in the middle of the street
With the joy of the spirit moving through my feet
I don't care who's watching, I don't care who's there
I'm just a young man living on a stone and a prayer
Yeah, it's a beautiful sound, it's a beautiful thing
To be dancing in the presence of the king of kings
Just a shepherd boy
Yeah, I'm the one he chose
Dancing for you
Thanks for watching!
